description.default: Build and clean the current Flutter or Android project.
description.zh-CN: 为当前 Flutter / Android 项目提供构建与清理工具。

description.default: Shows a floating ball while AiCode is in the background and expands it into an approval panel when the AI needs permission. Foreground requests are passed straight back to the in-app dialog.
description.zh-CN: AiCode 在后台时显示悬浮球；AI 需要授权时展开审批面板。App 在前台时直接交回应用内确认框，不阻塞审批。

description.default: Runs a local OpenAI-compatible gateway for SenseNova Raccoon Work in the container, with a pooled account pool, automatic token refresh, daily check-in, and QR-code / SMS login.
description.zh-CN: 在容器内运行商汤小浣熊（Raccoon Work）的本地 OpenAI 兼容网关，支持账号池轮换、令牌自动续期、每日自动签到，以及扫码与短信登录。
破甲提示词一键部署进 prompts.custom：完整版/精简版、全局/项目级、自动备份与一键回滚。纯页面实现，不依赖插件进程。
description.default: Deploy the armor prompt into prompts.custom: full/lite, global/project, auto backup and rollback. Pure page implementation.
Self-contained WorkBuddy gateway: manages accounts, talks to upstream directly, exposes OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoints.
description.zh-CN: 独立运行的 WorkBuddy 网关：插件内管理账号、直连上游，对外提供 OpenAI 兼容 /v1 接口。

description.default: Three-view transparent desktop pet: click to interact, drag to move, bubble auto-fits. Sprites from 1190fasheqi/dafeiyu-pet (MIT). Muse port by 惊寒.
description.zh-CN: 三视图透明桌宠：单击互动、拖拽移动、气泡随内容自适应。形象与台词来自 1190fasheqi/dafeiyu-pet（MIT）。muse 适配：惊寒。

description.default: List installed runtime tools and dependencies in the current environment, grouped with versions. By 惊寒.
description.zh-CN: 探测并显示当前执行环境里已安装的运行时与依赖，按类别分组并带版本号。作者：惊寒。

description.default: Write text to the system clipboard and show a compact copy tip; read clipboard text for context. Includes a minimal config page.
description.zh-CN: 把文本写入系统剪贴板并弹出精简提示条；也能读取剪贴板内容喂给模型；附带一个极简配置页。

description.default: GitHub workspace tools after login: dashboard, repositories, branches, commits, issues, pulls, file browsing, search — exposed both as plugin tools and a local MCP server.
description.zh-CN: 登录 GitHub 后自动获取你的仓库项目：账号工作台、仓库列表与详情、语言构成、分支、提交、Issue/PR、代码浏览与搜索，全部工具同时以本地 MCP 服务对外提供，可接入任意 MCP 客户端。
